source.quote: With respect to guidance, we are increasing the midpoint of 2025 FFO per share by $0.01 to $2.67 while narrowing the overall range.
We are establishing third-quarter guidance for FFO per share as adjusted for comparability in a range of $0.66 to $0.68.

source.quote: We reported 2025 FFO per share of $2.72, which was $0.02 above the midpoint of our revised guidance and $0.06 above our initial guidance.
Finally, we are establishing second quarter guidance for FFO per share in a range of $0.68 to $0.70.
For the first quarter, FFO per share was $0.69, which is $0.01 above the midpoint of guidance and represents a 6.2% year-over-year increase.

Our revised guidance reflects overcoming that incremental drag and increasing the midpoint of our FFO per share guidance from our initial estimate by $0.05 to $2.80 per share equating to roughly 3% growth.
For the third quarter, FFO per share was $0.71 which was $0.02 above the midpoint of guidance and represents 2.9% increase year over year.
